subject: __kCFAllocatorSystemDefault

observation.summary: The macOS 27 arm64e CoreFoundation export trie exposes kCFAllocatorDefault, kCFAllocatorSystemDefault, kCFAllocatorMalloc, kCFAllocatorMallocZone, kCFAllocatorNull and kCFNull, but contains no row for the double-underscore __kCFAllocatorSystemDefault. CF-Lite declares that name as 'static struct __CFAllocator __kCFAllocatorSystemDefault', i.e. internal linkage, so it is not expected in the export trie.

claim: __kCFAllocatorSystemDefault is not an exported CoreFoundation symbol on macOS 27 arm64e; the public allocator constants such as kCFAllocatorSystemDefault are exported, while the double-underscore backing object has internal linkage in the mirror and is therefore not part of the linkable ABI.
reproducer:
CF=/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation
dyld_info -uuid "$CF"            # expect UUID F4CE3D4A-29B8-3F98-A136-7089CEB27692
dyld_info -exports "$CF" | grep -E '(_kCFAllocator[A-Za-z]*|__kCFNull|_kCFNull)'
